title: The Paired Qi Cuts of the Azure Machete
summary: Teaches the machete as a pair of cuts on twin tracks of qi that meet in the foe's guard.

title: River Delta Treatise on the Heavy Blade
summary: Branches one heavy stroke into many channels of qi like a river reaching the sea.

title: The Two Stoops of the Hawk Blade
summary: Trains a double stoop in which the first dive draws the guard and the second strikes through it.

title: Basin Floor Methods of the Great Machete
summary: Methods that gather the field low like water in a basin and release it in a surge of heavy cuts.

title: Twin-Court Treatise on Felling and Clearing
summary: Pairs felling cuts and clearing sweeps as two courts of one blade that answer each other.

title: The Paired Horizon Canon of Field Cutting
summary: A canon that sets two lines of field qi at the horizon and cuts the foe between them.

title: Oath of the Open Edge Treatise
summary: Sets the machete's open edge under an oath that the cut will be carried through to the end.

title: A Wind-Sworn Canon of the Plateau Machete
summary: Teaches the plateau machete to move with the wind and strike in the instant it turns.

title: Bearing and Gale Methods for the Heavy Blade
summary: Joins a held bearing to the rush of the gale so that each heavy cut arrives on a chosen heading.

title: The Long Wind Treatise on Clearing Cuts
summary: A treatise of long clearing cuts that open a path through any number of foes along the wind.

title: The Treatise of No Walls and Open Cutting
summary: A treatise of the open field in which a cutter keeps no cover and wins by reach and nerve.

title: Oath-Sworn Gale Cuts of the Brush Hand
summary: Binds a gale of qi to the brush hand by oath so the strokes fall without hesitation.
